description: Validate a finished HyperCodeMotion composition and package it as a .hcmotion project file, the format HyperCodeMotion Studio opens. If the composition has problems, returns created: false with the errors to fix and stores nothing. On success, stores the file temporarily and returns an `open` link (opens the project in HyperCodeMotion Studio) and a `download` link; both expire 24 hours after creation. Pass the user's images, videos and audio in `media` (public https links, or files sent with start_media_upload) and they travel inside the file, so the project opens complete. It does not render video or generate media.

json.description: The full composition (version, name, width, height, fps, duration, background, layers…), as an object or JSON-encoded string.

media.description: The user's images, videos, audio or fonts to pack inside the file (binary, max 200 MB in total). Each item: {id, url} with a public https link the server downloads, or {id, upload} with the upload code from start_media_upload once the file was received. Layers use it as props.asset = id (image, video, audio) or in an HTML scene.

name: create_hcmotion
title: Create HyperCodeMotion project file
